description: This Java source file defines the MyAdmin class, a DeviceAdminReceiver for device administration functionalities in an Android application. It manages administrative status and triggers a restart in certain events.

classes.name: MyAdmin
classes.description: A DeviceAdminReceiver implementation that manages device admin state and triggers a restart through MyMain.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the ComponentName associated with this admin receiver.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether this admin is currently active/enabled.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Removes this admin from active admin list.

methods.name: onEnabled
methods.description: Callback when the admin has been enabled; triggers a restart.

methods.name: onDisabled
methods.description: Callback when the admin has been disabled; triggers a restart.
